briefing: You have done enough to be asked. There is a door where no chart reaches, and something guards it.
Arm the mis-jump, and clear the guard. Some call what lies behind it Raxxla.
Ask no one who sent this word. When the door falls, you will know who asked: {PATRON}.

door.arrive: Clear the guard at {TARGET} to open the door beyond
door.success: The guard falls at {TARGET}; the door opens at last
door.fail: The deadline passes over {TARGET}; the door stays sealed

dossier.lead: An unsigned note asks for a word, and gives no world to find it.

rumour.far: Pilots trade rumours of a wheel that has no face and no name.
rumour.near: An unsigned line reaches the commander, and asks for a word.

dossier.news: Word passes through the underworld that unseen hands are hiring again.

story.opening: On day {DAY}, the commander accepted a note that named no sender.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, the guard fell, and the door stood open at last.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, the trail went cold, and the door stayed sealed.

door.targetDestroyed: On day {DAY}, the guard died in {WORLD}, and the door stood open.
door.failed: By day {DAY}, the hunt in {WORLD} failed, and the door stayed shut.

dossier.title: The Door Beyond Charts
